Law 21 - No Ball

21.1 Front foot no ball

The bowler oversteps if, at the moment of delivery, no part of the front foot is behind the popping crease. When this happens the delivery is called a no ball and the batting side is awarded an extra run.

21.2 Back foot no ball

The delivery is also a no ball if the bowler's back foot lands outside the return crease at the point of delivery, regardless of where the front foot lands.
